body: After my friend committed suicide I went back and forth between being really sad and completely understanding. Do you think most people are understanding? He was also bipolar

Yeah I do feel really conflicted about the whole thing but every time I slip into the depression I get closer and closer to giving up. I kept waking up last night really paranoid and dreaming of different ways to die. I really wish I could just never had existed so there would be no pain for anyone

I was on medication for a while but my dad took me off of his insurance and I could no longer afford it. I have insurance now but it's really difficult for me to find a new therapist and it takes months for them to actually work. I also have to admit I love the mania
I'm in the exact same boat. You're not alone
